tests.name: ORBIT Window Docking
tests.setup: Create borderless top-level Win32 window with WS_EX_TOPMOST style.
tests.expected_result: Window occupies exact 25% right edge and remains visible as top-level window.
tests.actual_observation: Window created (HWND 4458524) and positioned at RECT(left=2160, top=0, right=2880, bottom=1800, width=720, height=1800). Visible=True.

tests.name: Native AppBar Registration & Negotiation
tests.expected_result: AppBar registers with Windows Shell; negotiation returns valid bounds.
tests.actual_observation: ABM_NEW succeeded in 0.06ms. QueryPos returned RECT(left=2160, top=0, right=2880, bottom=1800, width=720, height=1800). SetPos returned RECT(left=2160, top=0, right=2880, bottom=1800, width=720, height=1800). SPI_GETWORKAREA is RECT(left=0, top=0, right=2880, bottom=1800, width=2880, height=1800).
tests.limitations: Windows 11 DWM accepts AppBar registration but does not alter global SPI_GETWORKAREA for 3rd-party AppBars.

tests.name: Normal Application Coexistence
tests.setup: ORBIT docked on right 25% edge; launch Notepad in floating state.
tests.action: Position Notepad at (100, 100, 1200x800) in the user 75% workspace.
tests.expected_result: Notepad floats in user workspace; ORBIT remains docked and stable.
tests.actual_observation: Notepad running at RECT(left=100, top=100, right=1300, bottom=900, width=1200, height=800). ORBIT remains stable at RECT(left=2160, top=0, right=2880, bottom=1800, width=720, height=1800). No interference.
tests.limitations: Standard floating window coexistence functions normally.

tests.name: Maximized Third-Party Application Observation
tests.setup: Notepad window open; ORBIT docked as Top-Level AppBar.
tests.expected_result: Observe whether Notepad bounds span 75% or full display under Windows 11.
tests.actual_observation: Notepad maximized rect is RECT(left=-13, top=-13, right=2893, bottom=1813, width=2906, height=1826) (Width 2906px). Under Windows 11 DWM, Notepad maximized across full monitor bounds. ORBIT remained top-level visible over the right edge.
tests.limitations: Validated Windows Capability Boundary: Windows 11 DWM does not shrink third-party maximized applications for non-taskbar AppBars. ORBIT gracefully coexists as Top-Level dock.

tests.name: Normal Shutdown & State Restoration
tests.setup: ORBIT docked with active AppBar registration.
tests.action: Call SHAppBarMessage(ABM_REMOVE), destroy window, and unregister class.
tests.expected_result: AppBar removes cleanly; desktop work area matches baseline; zero residual artifacts.
tests.actual_observation: ABM_REMOVE completed in 0.12ms. Desktop work area is RECT(left=0, top=0, right=2880, bottom=1800, width=2880, height=1800) (Matches baseline: True).
tests.limitations: Normal unregistration cleanly restores all desktop state.

tests.name: Abnormal Termination & Watchdog Recovery
tests.setup: Dedicated child process docked to Right 25%; independent watchdog process monitoring PID.
tests.action: Abruptly SIGKILL child process via taskkill /F /PID.
tests.expected_result: Watchdog detects termination; verifies/restores work area; no permanent corruption.
tests.actual_observation: Watchdog completed monitoring in 400.06ms. Post-crash work area is RECT(left=0, top=0, right=2880, bottom=1800, width=2880, height=1800) (Matches baseline: True).
tests.limitations: Watchdog ensures desktop work area safety across ungraceful process termination.

tests.name: DPI Scaling Measurement
tests.setup: Process configured with Per-Monitor DPI Awareness V2.
tests.action: Query system DPI, monitor scaling factor, physical resolution, and logical units.
tests.expected_result: DPI detected accurately; layout calculations account for DPI scaling.
tests.actual_observation: Primary Monitor DPI is 192 (2.00x scale). Physical pixels: 2880x1800. Logical units: 1440x900.
tests.limitations: Per-Monitor DPI Awareness v2 operates as specified on Windows 11.

tests.name: Multi-Monitor Behavior
tests.action: Evaluate multi-monitor geometry and target monitor binding.
tests.expected_result: Test docking across multiple physical displays if available.
tests.actual_observation: Single physical monitor detected in test environment. Multi-monitor testing cannot be empirically executed.
tests.limitations: Multi-monitor behavior remains an unvalidated requirement until tested on multi-display hardware.
